result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d help people understand each other more deeply—especially across differences.

Not because disagreement would disappear, but because so much harm comes from fear, miscommunication, and seeing others as less human. Greater empathy wouldn’t solve every problem, but it would make us better at solving them together.
